summary: Put a tool in the cart and see what it comes to
description: The cart is the last thing a shopper reads before paying, so the arithmetic on it has to be right and it has to be reversible. It lives against the signed-in account rather than in the browser.
acceptanceCriteria: A product added from its page appears in the cart with the quantity that was chosen.
The line total for a product is its unit price multiplied by its quantity.
The order total is the sum of the line totals.
A product removed from the cart is gone from it.
